content:
mira: Heads up  we finished an interview with LatticeAI. They gave a concise hero quote and want a short embargo until 2026-04-06 08:00 PDT. Need signed permission + legal check for comparative claims.

logan: Quote candidate: "Redwood made our inference predictable across cloud regions  we reduced on-call pages and lowered cost per inference by roughly 35%."

anya: I'll draft the landing copy and social snippets. Planning 1 long-form case study + 3 social tiles + a webinar CTA.

violet: For legal: please attach transcript and indicate if the 35% is an internal 90-day avg vs prior infra. We'll need supporting calc or rephrase to "~35%". Also need permission for logo/headshot.

upload-bot: Transcript uploaded: /recordings/latticeai-2026-03-23/transcript.v1.txt

logan: Confirmed: 35% is 90-day avg vs previous infra. I'll get LatticeAI to sign the permission PDF today. They prefer no email public attribution. Attribution: "Kai Morales, Head of ML, LatticeAI".

rafa: Lead plan: add HubSpot form variant on the case study page with property cs_source=latticeai -> workflow tags leads `lattice-cs-warm` -> SF queue "CS - LatticeAI". Also create webinar segment `lattice-webinar-apr`.

mira: Good. Please include utm_campaign=cs_latticeai_2026 and set cookie expiry 30d. We'll A/B test two hero quotes in the first 48h.

violet: Once permission PDF is uploaded and transcript available, I can do a quick redline. Slipped timelines if permission comes late.

logan: Permission PDF uploaded: /permissions/latticeai/permission-signed-2026-03-23.pdf

anya: Draft ETA: initial drafts in drive by EOD Thu. Will include both hero quote variants and a short 30s clip.

rafa: I'll wire the HubSpot workflow this afternoon and leave notes for SDRs to prioritize `lattice-cs-warm` leads for webinar invites.

mira: Action items:
- logan: confirm signed permission (done)
- violet: legal redline (Mon)
- anya: draft assets + share link (EOD Thu)
- rafa: HubSpot workflow + UTMs (today)

mira: Tagging @here for visibility :sparkles:
